notes: Fixed background-enrichment tabs silently losing their anti-throttle shim on LinkedIn. LinkedIn tightened its Content-Security-Policy to block inline <script> execution, which is exactly how bg_visibility.js used to patch the page (a Content Security Policy console error, visible in chrome://extensions). The shim now runs natively in the page's own JS context via Chrome's MAIN-world content script support, so it isn't affected by the page's script-src policy at all — Contact Info enrichment in background tabs is reliable again.
